# routeros_disk_btrfs_filesystem (Resource)




<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `uuid` (String) The UUID of the Btrfs file system. The file system has to exist already; it is looked up by this UUID.

### Optional

- `___id___` (Number) <em>Resource ID type (.id / name). This is an internal service field, setting a value is not required.</em>
- `___path___` (String) <em>Resource path for CRUD operations. This is an internal service field, setting a value is not required.</em>
- `___skip___` (String) <em>A set of transformations for field names. This is an internal service field, setting a value is not required.</em>
- `default_subvolume` (String) The subvolume that is mounted as the root of the file system when no subvolume is given explicitly.
- `label` (String) The label of the Btrfs file system.

### Read-Only

- `balance_status` (String) The progress of the running or last balance operation.
- `balancing` (Boolean) Whether a balance operation is currently running.
- `corruption_errors` (String) The number of corruption errors recorded by the file system.
- `dev_ids` (String) The internal Btrfs device ids of the devices that make up the file system.
- `devs` (String) The devices that make up the file system.
- `flush_errors` (String) The number of flush errors recorded by the file system.
- `generation_errors` (String) The number of generation errors recorded by the file system.
- `id` (String) The ID of this resource.
- `missing_devs` (String) The devices of the file system that are currently missing.
- `read_errors` (String) The number of read errors recorded by the file system.
- `replace_status` (String) The progress of the running or last device replace operation.
- `replacing` (Boolean) Whether a device replace operation is currently running.
- `scrub_status` (String) The progress of the running or last scrub operation.
- `scrubbing` (Boolean) Whether a scrub operation is currently running.
- `spaces` (String) The allocation of the data, metadata and system block groups.
- `total_devs` (String) The number of devices that make up the file system.
- `write_errors` (String) The number of write errors recorded by the file system.
